instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. In an indoor studio with a pastel pink and purple gradient backdrop, the woman in the red fringed dress (R1) and the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) dance side-by-side. On the left, the woman in the red fringed dress (R1) faces right, smiling warmly with her arms bent in motion. On the right, the blonde woman (R3) faces forward, looking directly at the camera with a bright smile and her arms spread wide. They move energetically to the music without physical contact. The studio is bathed in soft, colorful lighting with a warm pink and cool blue gradient.
